name: io.github.c-mongan/ireland-mcp
title: Ireland MCP
description: Read-only Irish public data: CSO, Oireachtas, weather, transport, energy, rivers, laws, property.

environmentVariables.name: NTA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional NTA developer portal key for the live transport tools; every other tool works without it.

environmentVariables.name: PPR_INDEX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Property Price Register index built with `npm run ppr:build`; without it PPR tools fetch the county CSV live.
